# Where each vendor document came from, one line per folder or file: `path  # source`.
#
# Authority is not a property of a PDF. Two of ours are Wayback Machine copies because st.com
# refuses this host, and two are distributors' mirrors of the manufacturer's own file. A reader
# has to be able to see which is which, and until 11 September 2026 only the 29 documents
# fetched the day before had their source recorded anywhere.
#
# Folder lines are the backfill, taken from this folder's own README table, which is the
# granularity that record keeps. File lines override them and are written when a file is fetched.

# Added 26 September 2026 (MESHSAT-1357, stream PKT of the review of 26 September 2026). One line per new file: the URL
